protocol.mae_difference_display_unit: native full-scale MAE difference multiplied by 100; conversion points, not probability points or relative improvement

bootstrap.interval: paired percentile 95%; conditional on the one fixed training fit

protocol.correlation: SciPy Pearson statistic on both symmetric directions per unordered pair; descriptive antisymmetric association only; no p-value or row-level interval

results.interpretation: both paired intervals include zero; no superiority claim

limitations: 3356 directed rows are not independent observations; study is the split and bootstrap unit.
The test interval is conditional on a single fixed training fit and excludes full training-fit and effect-sampling uncertainty.
Study holdout does not establish that studies were unseen during model pretraining.
This does not reproduce the original random-reference, attenuation correction, LOSO pilot, or megastudy top-20-percent selection protocol.
No human benefit, harm, cost, welfare, individual behavior change, or superiority is established; no P4 or E16 completion claim follows.
